# Grant van Zyl

> Operations and digital production professional based in Exeter, UK. Twenty-five years across logistics, licensed consumer goods, compliance, data services and vehicle operations. Currently a Defleet Advisor at Switch/Thrifty, and open to operations, administration, digital production and business development roles — on site, hybrid or remote.

Grant builds the process where there isn't one, and increasingly the software that runs it. His active project, below, is unfinished — not a shipped, final product.

## Pages

- [CV](https://ericdarkomen.github.io/AboutMe/cv.html): the full curriculum vitae, also available as a [PDF](https://ericdarkomen.github.io/AboutMe/assets/Grant-van-Zyl-CV.pdf).

## Active project (work in progress)

- **Long Fall** — a sci-fi story game and real-time colony builder for the browser, roughly 66,000 lines of HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step and no dependencies. Ten ages from flint to rockets, built on an operations model (jobs, production queues, stock, haulage, spoilage), with its own level editor. Playable at https://anomalycraft.com/longfall/.

## Career

- Defleet Advisor, Switch / Thrifty (Scot Group Ltd) — Nov 2025–present, Exeter
- Cargo Clerical Officer / Continuous Improvement Champion, IAG Cargo — 2020–2022, London Heathrow
- Product Development / Digital Production / Data Services / IT, Grant and Bowman Ltd — 2007–2020
- Business Development, Transfer 2000 — 2006–2007
- Operations Management / Client Implementation, TNT Express (now FedEx) — 2002–2005

## Skills

Digital production (Adobe Illustrator & Photoshop, product design, licensed brand materials, sales copy and marketing content); AI-assisted development (Claude, Copilot, Cursor); software development (HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, C#, WordPress, Shopify, SharePoint, Unreal Engine, Unity); operations (multi-site management, business launch and remediation, process design); continuous improvement (Six Sigma DMAIC, Lean 5S, 5-Why RCA, Gemba walks); data and analysis (SQL, Excel — lookups, pivots, Power Query, DAX); administration (invoicing, V5 & DVLA documentation, records management).
